other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Data preprocessing steps (such as imputation, frequency encoding, global target means, and TF-IDF vectorization) are fit on the full training dataset before cross-validation splitting. This leaks validation fold statistics into the training folds, leading to overly optimistic out-of-fold validation scores and slightly biased models.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated and structurally sound solution, utilizing strong feature engineering, deep learning alongside gradient boosting, and an optimized ensemble. Its only moderate flaw is performing several dataset-wide preprocessing steps (like median calculation, TF-IDF, and frequency encoding) on the full training set before cross-validation splitting, which introduces minor CV leakage.
